items.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997
items.q: And after Maynard’s band it was such a letdown for me... I tried to get my job back and Maynard was furious with me for leaving.

ctx.x: A major infraction. © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

And it’s strange. I wanted to go back to school, and I mean it was two weeks before final exams, and I got a call from Maynard Ferguson. I didn’t even say goodbye. The next night I played my first note at Birdland.
